title: tilia americana var. missisippiensis
intro: Tilia americana var. missisippiensis, commonly known as American Linden or Southern Linden, is a deciduous tree belonging to the family Malvaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Tilia americana var. missisippiensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as acting as a sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, particularly linalool and alpha-hydroxy-alpha-terpineol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
